responsibility: Declares and wires up the x86 Rust front-end target hook. This small header exports `ix86_rust_target_cpu_info` and binds it to `TARGET_RUST_CPU_INFO`, making it the interface layer that connects the generic Rust front end to the x86-specific feature-reporting implementation in `i386-rust.cc`.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface/header side of the i386-rust pair: it only declares `ix86_rust_target_cpu_info` and maps `TARGET_RUST_CPU_INFO` to that symbol for the x86 target. Unlike `i386-rust.cc`, it contains no feature-detection or `rust_add_target_info` emission logic.
